NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_acronyms¶

Back to Note NLP Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_acronyms(const Note& other) const

Acronym-Set Containment Score Between Two Notes¶

overlap_acronyms(other) scores each cell pair by the overlap coefficient of their acronym sets and returns a shape-preserving Note of score strings. It is the acronym-set containment member of the set-similarity family; see also jaccard_acronyms and intersect_acronyms.

How the score is computed¶

An acronym is a run of two or more uppercase ASCII letters on a word boundary (NASA, ESA); matches are lowercased and deduplicated into sets A and B. The score is |A ∩ B| / min(|A|, |B|), in [0, 1], symmetric — 1.0 when the smaller acronym set is contained in the larger.

A cell with no uppercase letters has an empty acronym set. Both sets empty → 1.0; one empty and one not → 0.0. The default printer shows up to six decimals, trailing zeros trimmed.

Shape, pairing, and rejections¶

Per cell and pairwise; equal numel or a scalar (numel() == 1) broadcast. Bytes-mode input raises NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_acronyms requires a UTF-8 text Note (lhs is bytes) (or rhs); a numel mismatch raises NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_acronyms expects equal numel or scalar broadcast.

Example 1: Smaller Set Fully Contained¶

std::cout << pluss::make_note({"NASA ESA"})
                 .nlp().overlap_acronyms(pluss::make_note({"NASA ESA NOAA JAXA"}))
          << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, dtype=Float64)
[1]

{nasa, esa} is a subset of {nasa, esa, noaa, jaxa}, so the coefficient is 1.0. jaccard_acronyms here would give 2/4 = 0.5.

See Also¶

  • NoteNlpAccessor::jaccard_acronyms: the mutual-similarity score over the same sets.

  • NoteNlpAccessor::intersect_acronyms: the shared acronyms themselves.

  • NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_tokens / NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_terms / NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_citations / NoteNlpAccessor::overlap_symbols: other set kinds.
